main_text.l: Graiísque vix notus fuis,Cultu Latino nunc superbus ambulansVates vetultos provocat.Hunc fuscitare qui potueris mortuum,Fors & meos fraterculosSanare penitus si minus queas, tamenA fauce mortis eruës.Nec id laboro delicato in ocioVt suauiter curent cutem:Satis superque est si maligne victitent,Pannis & annis obsiti,Laceri flagellis, aridi, famelici,Quae vita digna est fratribus:Diuque viuant & poenas luant diu,Mortémque timeant & velint.

page.notes: The woodcut ornament below the verse is a printer's device and is not transcribed. The verse lines are printed with the lines of each stanza run together; the ornament and the catchword-like word "GEORGII" are its signature line. Some letters are faint and may be misread in places, notably "Graiísque" and "Vates".
